system: Worldshepherd QRF External Evidence Partner Target Matrix

selection_policy: Rank by shortest defensible path to a specific QRF campaign gate, evidence quality, integration relevance, and current access/partner signal. Scores are internal fit scores, not probabilities of agreement.

claim_control: This matrix is current partner/access intelligence, not proof of availability to Worldshepherd, not an endorsement, and not evidence that any campaign gate has been satisfied. Vendor statements remain vendor-attributed until artifacts pass QRF structural intake and identified-human technical review. Every volatile external fact must be re-verified at execution time.
